calcColumns: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( 'Enrollments'[final_score] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( 'Enrollments'[Prior Subject Score] ), 'Enrollments'[final_score] - 'Enrollments'[Prior Subject Score] )
measures: Number of students in the current selection
Exam results where the student sat the exam
Average exam score of students who sat the exam
DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Exam Results' ), 'Exam Results'[is_pass] = 1 ), [Exam Sittings] )
Share of sat exams scored at or above the pass mark (50)
DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Exam Results' ), 'Exam Results'[grade_letter] = "A" ), [Exam Sittings] )
Share of sat exams graded A (85+)
DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Exam Results' ), 'Exam Results'[attendance_status] = "No-show" ), COUNTROWS ( 'Exam Results' ) )
Share of scheduled exams the student missed
Correct answers divided by attempted questions

VAR curT = CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'Term'[term_key] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Term' ) ) VAR priT = CALCULATE ( MIN ( 'Term'[term_key] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Term' ) ) VAR t = ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( 'Student'[student_key] ), "@cur", CALCULATE ( [Avg Exam Score], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Term' ), REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), 'Exam'[exam_type] = "Final", 'Exam'[term_key] = curT ), "@pri", CALCULATE ( [Avg Exam Score], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Term' ), REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), 'Exam'[exam_type] = "Final", 'Exam'[term_key] = priT ) ) RETURN AVERAGEX ( FILTER ( t, NOT ISBLANK ( [@cur] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( [@pri] ) ), [@cur] - [@pri] )
Year-over-year growth: latest final minus prior-year final, same students

VAR t = ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( 'Student'[student_key] ), "@m", CALCULATE ( [Avg Exam Score], 'Exam'[exam_type] = "Midterm", KEEPFILTERS ( 'Term'[is_current_year] = TRUE () ) ), "@f", CALCULATE ( [Avg Exam Score], 'Exam'[exam_type] = "Final", KEEPFILTERS ( 'Term'[is_current_year] = TRUE () ) ) ) RETURN AVERAGEX ( FILTER ( t, NOT ISBLANK ( [@m] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( [@f] ) ), [@f] - [@m] )
Within-term growth from midterm to final
CALCULATE ( [Avg Exam Score], 'Student'[family_income] = "High" ) - CALCULATE ( [Avg Exam Score], 'Student'[family_income] = "Low" )
Average score of High-income minus Low-income students
CALCULATE ( [Avg Exam Score], 'Student'[gender] = "Female" ) - CALCULATE ( [Avg Exam Score], 'Student'[gender] = "Male" )
Average score of female minus male students

VAR done = CALCULATETABLE ( 'Enrollments', 'Enrollments'[status] = "Completed" ) RETURN DIVIDE ( SUMX ( done, 'Enrollments'[grade_points] * 'Enrollments'[credits_attempted] ), SUMX ( done, 'Enrollments'[credits_attempted] ) )
Credit-weighted grade point average of completed courses
Average term score per course enrolment
Share of course enrolments that ended in withdrawal
Credits earned divided by credits attempted
Course score minus the student's prior-year final in the same subject

VAR g = [Avg Course Growth] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( g ), g - CALCULATE ( [Avg Course Growth], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Teacher' ), REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Class'[class_code], 'Class'[section], 'Class'[room], 'Class'[schedule_slot] ) ) )
Growth of the teacher's students minus average growth in the same subject and term

VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( 'Student'[student_key] ), CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Enrollments' ) ) > 0 ) VAR off = FILTER ( t, CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Enrollments' ), 'Subject'[is_core] = TRUE (), 'Enrollments'[final_grade] = "F" || 'Enrollments'[status] = "Withdrawn" ) > 0 ) RETURN DIVIDE ( COUNTROWS ( t ) - COUNTROWS ( off ), COUNTROWS ( t ) )
Students who passed every core course they took
CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Date' ), KEEPFILTERS ( 'Date'[is_school_day] = TRUE () ), KEEPFILTERS ( 'Term'[is_current_year] = TRUE () ) )
Instructional days in the selection (attendance is recorded for the current school year)
Students times school days: the attendance denominator
VAR d = [Student Days] RETURN IF ( d > 0, 1 - DIVIDE ( [Absent Days], d ) )
Share of student school days attended; attendance is stored as exceptions, so present days are implied by the calendar
Share of student school days with a late arrival
DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Attendance' ), 'Attendance'[status] = "Excused" ), CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Attendance' ), 'Attendance'[status] IN { "Excused", "Absent" } ) )
Excused absences divided by all absences

VAR days = [School Days] VAR t = ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( 'Student'[student_key] ), "@a", [Absent Days] ) RETURN IF ( days > 0, DIVIDE ( COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( t, [@a] > 0.1 * days ) ), COUNTROWS ( t ) ) )
Share of students who missed more than 10% of school days
DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Submissions' ), 'Submissions'[status] = "On time" ), CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Submissions' ), 'Submissions'[status] <> "Missing" ) )
Share of submitted assignments handed in on time
Points earned divided by points available on submitted work
DIVIDE ( SUM ( 'LMS Activity'[online_learning_min] ) + SUM ( 'LMS Activity'[online_course_min] ) + SUM ( 'LMS Activity'[edu_app_min] ), COUNTROWS ( 'LMS Activity' ) )
Online learning minutes per student per week
DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'LMS Activity' ), 'LMS Activity'[logins] > 0 ), COUNTROWS ( 'LMS Activity' ) )
Share of student-weeks with at least one LMS login
Share of students suspended at least once
DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Wellbeing Survey' ), 'Wellbeing Survey'[stress_level] >= 8 ), COUNTROWS ( 'Wellbeing Survey' ) )
Share of survey answers with stress 8 or higher
DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Wellbeing Survey' ), 'Wellbeing Survey'[sleep_hours] < 6 ), COUNTROWS ( 'Wellbeing Survey' ) )
Share of survey answers with under 6 hours of sleep
CALCULATE ( [Avg Exam Score], TREATAS ( VALUES ( 'Wellbeing Survey'[student_key] ), 'Student'[student_key] ) )
Average exam score of the students in the selected survey group
Pass rate of the students in the selected survey group

VAR a = [Attendance Rate] VAR inc = [Incidents] VAR susp = CALCULATE ( [Incidents], 'Incidents'[action_taken] = "Suspension" ) VAR f = CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Enrollments' ), 'Enrollments'[final_grade] = "F" ) VAR sc = [Avg Exam Score] RETURN IF ( HASONEVALUE ( 'Student'[student_key] ), INT ( NOT ISBLANK ( a ) && a < 0.9 ) + INT ( inc >= 2 || susp >= 1 ) + INT ( f >= 1 || ( NOT ISBLANK ( sc ) && sc < 55 ) ) )
ABC early-warning flags for one student: Attendance < 90%, Behaviour (2+ incidents or a suspension), Course performance (an F or average below 55)
VAR days = [School Days] RETURN IF ( days > 0, DIVIDE ( COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( 'Student'[student_key] ), [Absent Days] > 0.1 * days ) ), [Students] ) )
Share of students flagged on Attendance (below 90%)
DIVIDE ( COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( 'Student'[student_key] ), CALCULATE ( [Incidents] ) >= 2 || CALCULATE ( [Incidents], 'Incidents'[action_taken] = "Suspension" ) >= 1 ) ), [Students] )
Share of students flagged on Behaviour (2+ incidents or a suspension)

DIVIDE ( COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( 'Student'[student_key] ), "@f", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Enrollments' ), 'Enrollments'[final_grade] = "F" ), "@s", [Avg Exam Score] ), [@f] >= 1 || ( NOT ISBLANK ( [@s] ) && [@s] < 55 ) ) ), [Students] )
Share of students flagged on Course performance (an F or average below 55)
Students with at least one ABC flag
Share of students with at least one ABC flag
DIVIDE ( COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( 'Student'[student_key] ), CALCULATE ( [Risk Flags] ) >= 2 ) ), [Students] )
Share of students with two or more ABC flags
Students with at least one support programme
Share of students in a support programme
Programme sessions attended divided by planned

VAR ps = CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( 'Interventions'[student_key] ) ) VAR g1 = CALCULATE ( [Score Change], TREATAS ( ps, 'Student'[student_key] ) ) VAR g0 = CALCULATE ( [Score Change], EXCEPT ( VALUES ( 'Student'[student_key] ), ps ) ) RETURN g1 - g0
Year-over-year growth of programme participants minus non-participants
Average number of enrolments per class
DIVIDE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Enrollments' ), SUMX ( VALUES ( 'Class'[class_key] ), CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'Class'[capacity] ) ) ) )
